predecessors.name: Middle Kingdom of Egypt
predecessors.text: the Nile Delta, where a provincial family broke away from the 13th Dynasty

successors.name: Hyksos
successors.text: the Delta, which fell to the Hyksos 15th Dynasty around 1650

ledger.x: 1700: a provincial family in the Nile Delta breaks away and forms the Fourteenth Dynasty.
1650: the Fourteenth Dynasty falls to the Hyksos.
1650: the Delta kingdom of the Fourteenth Dynasty ends; the Hyksos take its land.

wars.name: Hyksos conquest of the Delta
wars.outcome: The 14th Dynasty fell quickly to Hyksos power around 1650 and the Hyksos ruled Lower Egypt from Avaris.

certainty.note: Ryholt gives the Delta with borders near Athribis and Bubastis; no page gives a frontier line.
